title: docs(adr): the EXTERNAL rung admits explicit grants — ADR-0095, 0099, 0090 and 0135 record ruling 6355206139 B
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoFqCf6db2fM7iSSM3dJb5rf)_

Refs #25233 (closed by #25541). This is the Tier H ADR text for the ruling of record 6355206139, letter B, item 2. It stays a draft for the maintainer to merge (`docs/adr/**` is a governed surface).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this does

The ADRs now say what #25515 and #25541 enforce. An EXTERNAL principal is a member of the organization's member pool who holds the `external` organization role. It reaches rows through explicit grants only: shares and share links, sharing rules, and the position and permission-set grants it holds, with their RLS evaluated. It never reaches the OWD baseline.

| ADR | Clause | Change |
|---|---|---|
| ADR-0095 | header, TL;DR item 2, D2 | A dated Amended line. The enum comment and the EXTERNAL bullet carry the channel list, the owner-only OWD and write floors, the `controlled_by_parent` exemption, and the named limit: an ownerless object with a public effective model is under no OWD for any principal. The original wording is quoted. |
| ADR-0095 | D3 | One bullet: EXTERNAL derives from the reserved `org_external` position, which the resolver projects from `sys_member.role = external`. As with `role='admin'`, the role is the source of a position, and enforcement reads the posture. |
| ADR-0099 | header, D2 table, D3, I3, I7 | The EXTERNAL column is rewritten, with a dated note superseding the 2026-07-18 note's "EXTERNAL rows stand as written" and quoting the original cells. D3 gains a head note: sharing rules apply, item 1 shipped, the ownerless-object limit, and explain's `guest` → `EXTERNAL` debugger mapping. I3 gains a dated note: EXTERNAL is the one exception to "only from capability grants", derived from the reserved `org_external` position by the resolver alone. I7 reads through the floor. |
| ADR-0090 | header, D11 | A Re-amended line and a second note under D11. "drawn from an identity pool separate from members" is replaced by the population inside the member pool, by role. The "D6 access matrix gains an external-audience column" sentence is retired, because it rode `externalSharingModel` and audience is a property of the principal. |
| ADR-0135 | after D4 | A dated objectstack note: a third population, members of either D2 source who hold the `external` role, marked by role on `sys_member` and not by `sys_user.source`. D4's markings are unchanged, and cloud ADR-0024's text is not amended. |

One source line rides along: `packages/core/src/security/external-owd-floor.ts`'s docblock no longer lists `controlled_by_parent` among the models the floor closes (the seat's carry note on #25541). It takes a `patch` changeset on `@objectstack/core`, comment only.

## Acceptance notes

- The text matches the code on `main` at 45f996231: `owdForAudience` and `owdForPrincipal` (the cbp exemption), `holdsExternalIdentity` and `derivePosture`, `external_default`'s owner-only write floor, and the authz-matrix EXTERNAL column.
- The notes from contract review 6375883728 are folded in: the D11 column sentence retired explicitly, the ownerless-object limit named, and the guest debugger mapping noted.
- Cloud ADR-0024's mirror text is not ours and is not touched.

Notes for review:

- **ADR-0095 D3 and ADR-0099 I3** said posture derives "only from capability grants". EXTERNAL is the one rung whose evidence is an identity position. The new D3 bullet and a dated note on I3 record that exception; the resolver stays the only deriver, and no enforcement site reads the role.
- **#25549** (share creation and sharing-rule materialisation refused as inert on effective-public objects) is still awaiting a ruling. Whatever the ruling, its ADR-0111 D7 line rides a later Tier H PR, not this one.

Verification: all 69 derived gates were run and reconciled with `dispatch-gates --ran` (0 not measured), including `check-adr-links`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors` and `check:doc-authoring`. The diff is 6 files. The I3 note (f653505be) re-derives the same 69, and the ADR, citation and doc-authoring gates re-pass on it.
